panel.hint: Click the bar widget to toggle this panel. Right-click it to open settings.
panel.title: KVitals

accent_color.label: Accent color
accent_color.description: Color used for critical values, graphs, and icons. Leave as primary to follow the theme.

display_mode.label: Bar display mode
display_mode.description: Show metric icons, text, or both in the bar.

enabled_battery.label: Show battery
enabled_battery.description: Show battery percentage and power draw.

enabled_gpu.label: Show GPU
enabled_gpu.description: Show GPU usage, temperature, and VRAM.

enabled_net.label: Show network
enabled_net.description: Show network up and down rates.

font_color.label: Font color
font_color.description: Color of the metric text. Leave as on_surface to follow the theme.

icon.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

icon_cpu.label: CPU icon
icon_cpu.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

icon_ram.label: RAM icon
icon_ram.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

icon_temp.label: Temperature icon
icon_temp.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

icon_gpu.label: GPU icon
icon_gpu.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

icon_vram.label: VRAM icon
icon_vram.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

icon_fan.label: Fan icon
icon_fan.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

icon_net.label: Network icon
icon_net.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

icon_disk.label: Disk icon
icon_disk.description: Choose the icon for this metric.

graph_height.label: Graph height
graph_height.description: Height of each sparkline in the panel.

hide_absent.label: Hide absent sensors
hide_absent.description: Hide metrics whose sensor is not present.

metric_order.label: Metric order
metric_order.description: Order of the metrics in the bar, panel, and desktop tile.

refresh_ms.label: Refresh interval (ms)
refresh_ms.description: How often the sensors are sampled.

show_cpu_freq.label: Show CPU frequency
show_cpu_freq.description: Show the current CPU clock in the CPU chip and panel.

show_graphs.label: Show graphs
show_graphs.description: Show live sparklines in the panel.

show_glyphs.label: Show icons
show_glyphs.description: Show metric icons in the desktop tile.

show_net_ip.label: Show IP address
show_net_ip.description: Show the local IPv4 address in the tooltip and panel.

show_power_draw.label: Show power draw
show_power_draw.description: Show the battery power draw in watts.

threshold.description: Values at or above this level tint the metric toward the accent color.

net_threshold.description: Network rates in MB/s. Values at or above this level tint the metric.
